verdict.rationale: Lever ships AI features (Talent Fit, AI Form Builder, interview summaries), so asking whether it can act as an MCP client is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence shows it can connect to or consume external MCP servers. Its webhooks, OAuth, Data API and integration marketplace are integration primitives, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
